faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon lubrication gear pumps and gear pump elements used for?
faqs.a: They are the gear pumps and gear pump elements used in Bijur Delimon oil lubrication and circulation units, listed for replacement and for building oil systems. The range covers V100, PR1, R25, R45, SF and MP100 types in 30 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read gear pump items such as AP3183 — LUB GEAR PUMP V100 1CC/REV?
faqs.a: The text gives the type and displacement: AP3183 is the V100 gear pump at 1 cc/rev, and AP3187 is the V100 at 0.5 cc/rev. R25/20 and R45/80 pumps carry a size number after the slash, and SF3/25RD-VLF means an SF3 pump with a VLF relief valve.

faqs.q: Which gear pump families are listed and how are they sized?
faqs.a: V100 elements are listed by displacement, 0.5 and 1 cc/rev. PR1 pumps come with motor coupling, R25 and R45 pumps with coupling, SF2 to SF4 pumps with VLF relief and MP100 as three-phase gear lubricators. Elements are chosen on displacement, rotation and mounting.

faqs.q: What rating does the PR1 gear pump 72811-7363 have?
faqs.a: Part 72811-7363 is listed as a PR1 3000 gear pump of 3 L/min at 35 bar. Other rows give displacement or size only, so ask us for the Bijur Delimon datasheet value for the pump you need.

faqs.q: Is there a Viton-sealed gear pump in the range?
faqs.a: Yes. Part 728116883 is the R25/12.5 flange gear pump with Viton seals. Other pumps are listed without seal material, so state your oil and temperature on the enquiry.

faqs.q: What drives and mountings do the Bijur Delimon gear pumps have?
faqs.a: PR1 and R25 pumps are listed with coupling or flange and coupling, R45/80 with coupling, and MP100 as three-phase gear lubricators at 1500 rpm (AP3218, AP3220). V100 elements are built into an existing lubrication unit.

faqs.q: How do I check rotation and mounting before ordering a gear pump element?
faqs.a: Gear pump elements are chosen on displacement, rotation and mounting. Part AP3188 is listed as a V100 0.2 cc right-hand rotation element, so state the direction as seen from the drive and the mounting when you enquire.

faqs.q: Gear pump elements compared with the rotary-drive oil gear pumps?
faqs.a: The elements and pumps here are built into oil lubrication and circulation units. The [rotary-drive oil gear pumps](/p/bijur-delimon-rotary-drive-oil-gear-pumps) are shaft-driven pumps for constant-feed and sealed applications. Choose on the drive you have.

faqs.q: Where are Bijur Delimon gear pumps used?
faqs.a: They are used in oil circulation systems and as replacement gear pumps in existing units. See the [Gear Pumps shelf](/c/lubrication-gear-pumps) and the [oil circulation systems](/c/oil-circulation-systems) shelf.

faqs.q: What documents come with the gear pumps?
faqs.a: Bijur Delimon datasheets and manuals are supplied where available for the range. Send the part number so we confirm the right document before quoting.

faqs.q: What do I need to send for a quotation on a gear pump or element?
faqs.a: Send the Bijur Delimon part number if you have it, otherwise the machine, the lubricant viscosity, the flow and pressure needed, the shaft speed and direction of rotation, and the mounting. We confirm the part number before quoting.

faqs.q: Do you keep Bijur Delimon lubrication gear pumps in stock, and how do I order?
faqs.a: Yes, the Bijur Delimon lubrication gear pumps and elements is held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and ships worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the part numbers and quantities via [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon mechanical lubricators and what do they do?
faqs.a: They are lubricators driven by the machine itself, through a connecting rod or an eccentric cam, so they deliver a little lubricant on each cycle while the machine runs. Three part numbers are listed: the LQ-B and LQ-S cable lubricators and the LeverMatic.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers 41606, 44434 and 24898 for mechanical lubricators?
faqs.a: 41606 is the LQ-B wire cable lubricator, 44434 is the LQ-S wire cable lubricator and 24898 is the LeverMatic with return line. Each part number is a separate model, so order by the number listed.

faqs.q: Which mechanical lubricators are listed?
faqs.a: The LQ-B (41606) and LQ-S (44434) lubricate wire cables, and the LeverMatic (24898) is lever-driven with a return line. The facts we hold for this range give no flow or pressure figures, so ask for the datasheet value you need.

faqs.q: What output do the LQ cable lubricators deliver?
faqs.a: They deliver a little lubricant on each cycle while the machine runs, in proportion to the machine's movement. The facts we hold give no output figure, so send us the cable size and speed and we confirm the lubricator.

faqs.q: What do the LQ-B and LQ-S lubricate?
faqs.a: The LQ-B and LQ-S lubricate wire cables, such as wire rope, as the cable passes through. Confirm the lubricant and cable diameter with us when you enquire.

faqs.q: What drives a LeverMatic lubricator?
faqs.a: The LeverMatic is lever-driven, with a return line, so it needs a machine with a reciprocating motion to move the lever. The machine drives it on each stroke.

faqs.q: Mechanical lubricators compared with gear pumps?
faqs.a: A mechanical lubricator delivers a small shot on each machine cycle, so it only works while the machine moves. [Rotary-drive oil gear pumps](/p/bijur-delimon-rotary-drive-oil-gear-pumps) deliver continuously from a rotating shaft. Choose on the motion you have.

faqs.q: Where are mechanical lubricators used?
faqs.a: They are used for wire rope and cable lubrication, and on machines with a reciprocating motion to drive the pump. See the [Gear Pumps shelf](/c/lubrication-gear-pumps) for the other mechanically driven lubricators.

faqs.q: Do the mechanical lubricators come with documents?
faqs.a: Bijur Delimon datasheets and manuals are supplied where available for the range. Send the part number so we confirm the right document before quoting.

faqs.q: What do I need to check before choosing a mechanical lubricator?
faqs.a: Check the available drive, the machine's cycle rate, the lubricant and the cable or point being lubricated. A mechanical pump delivers only while the machine runs, in proportion to its speed.

faqs.q: Can you supply the complete lubrication system around a mechanical lubricator?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply the pump with the Bijur Delimon distribution elements, tubing, fittings, controller and monitoring to suit the machine, and can propose the layout from a list of the lubrication points.

faqs.q: Do you keep Bijur Delimon mechanical lubricators in stock, and what do I send for a quote?
faqs.a: Yes. The Bijur Delimon mechanical lubricator is in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, with worldwide shipping at the best lead times. Request a quote by sending what you need through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon rotary-drive oil gear pumps used for?
faqs.a: They are oil gear pumps driven from a rotating machine shaft, directly or through a gear or chain drive of suitable ratio, for constant-feed and sealed applications. They feed gearbox and bearing oil on machines with a rotating shaft available.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers C2347, C2425, C2448 and C2478?
faqs.a: C2347 is the constant-feed pump, C2425 the reverse-rotation pump, C2448 and C2448-1 the sealed pumps, and C2478 the reverse sealed pump. Five part numbers are listed, each a separate version.

faqs.q: Which versions of the rotary-drive gear pump are available?
faqs.a: Five versions: constant feed (C2347), reverse (C2425), sealed (C2448 and C2448-1) and reverse sealed (C2478). The facts we hold give no displacement figures, so ask for the datasheet value you need.

faqs.q: How do I specify the direction of rotation for a rotary-drive gear pump?
faqs.a: Direction of drive is read looking at the exposed shaft end. Choose the standard or the reverse pump, such as C2425 or C2478, to match the shaft rotation of your machine.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a sealed and a standard rotary-drive gear pump?
faqs.a: The sealed versions, C2448, C2448-1 and C2478, are listed for sealed applications, while C2347 and C2425 are constant-feed and reverse pumps. State if the pump must be oil-tight against the machine casing.

faqs.q: What do I need to fit with a rotary-drive gear pump that has a suction head?
faqs.a: Where the pump has a suction head, fit inlet valve B5892. Also check the available drive: shaft speed, direction of rotation and a suitable gear or chain ratio.

faqs.q: Rotary-drive gear pumps compared with the gear pump elements?
faqs.a: The rotary-drive pumps bolt to a rotating shaft on the machine. The [lubrication gear pumps and elements](/p/bijur-delimon-lubrication-gear-pumps-and-gear-pump-elements) are built into oil lubrication and circulation units. Choose on whether you have a shaft to drive the pump.

faqs.q: Where are rotary-drive oil gear pumps used?
faqs.a: They are used for gearbox and bearing oil feed on machines with a rotating shaft. See the [Gear Pumps shelf](/c/lubrication-gear-pumps) for other mechanically driven pumps.

faqs.q: Where is the datasheet for the rotary-drive gear pumps?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Gear Pump Datasheet is in the Downloads tab for this range. Send the part number if you need a specific version checked against it.

faqs.q: What affects how much a shaft-driven gear pump delivers?
faqs.a: A shaft-driven pump delivers only while the machine runs, in proportion to its speed. Check the available drive, the oil viscosity and the flow and pressure the system needs.

faqs.q: Can you supply the complete lubrication system around the rotary-drive gear pump?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply the pump with the Bijur Delimon distribution elements, tubing, fittings, controller and monitoring to suit the machine, and can propose the layout from a list of the lubrication points.

faqs.q: Do you keep Bijur Delimon rotary-drive oil gear pumps in stock, and how do I order?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the Bijur Delimon rotary-drive oil gear pump in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
